profile.headline: Software Developer at Liberty Mutual Insurance

positions.title: Quality Management Analyst
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Business to prioritize and rationalize project requirements
• Led the efforts of creating and maintaining all the test deliverables
• Executed integration, functional, regression, automated and end-to-end testing
• Assisted Business with use cases for execution during User Acceptance Testing
• Facilitated meetings with Development team to discuss defects logged in StarTeam and JIRA

positions.title: Computer Support Technician
positions.description:
•	Setup new Macs and PCs and install necessary software for proper school usage
•	Replace or upgrade old computer of faculty members in computer labs
•	Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issue requests from school faculty and administration
•	Log and update equipment information into database system

positions.title: Computer Lab Consultant
positions.description:
•	Troubleshoot network, PC, and printer dysfunctions for students and faculty
•	Stay up-to-date and knowledgeable on all lab equipment and software
•	Maintain daily inventory of printers, toners, paper and cleaning supplies

positions.title: Host Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed register daily transactions and analyzed balance discrepancies
•	Managed customer relations to improve sales of the company  
•	Educated new employees to serve customers in a courteous manner
•	Supervised and coordinated activities of dining room

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description:
•	Efficiently and accurately processed data into an Excel database
•	Compared complex data with sources to verify format and detect errors

positions.title: Orientation Leader
positions.description:
•	Hosted informative workshops and team-building activities for incoming freshman
•	Assisted students with the enrollment process and academic advising
